features.title: Skill for Claude Code and Codex
features.what: It installs as a skill folder so the agent picks it up by itself.
features.evidence_quote: unslop is a skill for Claude Code and Codex that turns vibecoded, AI-looking UI into a designed interface with its own character.

features.title: Audit, then a direction
features.what: It lists every sign of slop and where it lives before it edits anything.
features.evidence_quote: It audits the screen and proposes a direction before it edits anything, so you can steer it early.

features.title: Passes in a fixed order
features.what: Spacing, color, icons, copy, type, layout, details, visuals and motion, in that order.
features.evidence_quote: Passes. Spacing, color, icons, copy, type, layout, details, visuals and motion, in that order.

features.title: Runs in the viewer's stack
features.what: It handles the frameworks the screen is built with, live sites included.
features.evidence_quote: It works in whatever your screen is built with, like Next.js, React, Vue, Svelte, Tailwind or plain HTML and CSS

features.title: Story video of the fix
features.what: It cuts a short square video of the screen unslopping itself.
features.evidence_quote: Story video. A square video under 10 seconds of your screen unslopping itself, ready to post.

features.title: Extra tools for the video
features.what: The story video needs two more tools installed on the machine.
features.evidence_quote: Story videos also require ffmpeg installed and available on your PATH.

risks.text: It is an agent skill: it needs Claude Code or Codex, plus Playwright and ffmpeg for the story video.
Image generation for a hero is optional and paid, and it asks before every generation.
